subject.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads

question: Should workspace hook package.json and HOOK.md files larger than 1 MiB become unsupported and be warned-and-skipped during discovery?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but choosing a hard ceiling changes compatibility for existing oversized hook metadata and cannot be inferred solely from tests or CI.

options.title: Accept the 1 MiB ceiling
options.body: Merge the current warn-and-skip behavior as a deliberate resource-safety boundary after refreshing the branch and checks.

options.title: Revise the boundary first
options.body: Choose a different documented ceiling or rejection contract and update the tests and real behavior proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept the 1 MiB ceiling
recommendation.body: Merge the current warn-and-skip behavior as a deliberate resource-safety boundary after refreshing the branch and checks.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available current-main history signal for the workspace hook loader, though explicit ownership evidence is limited.
